articles.summary: AdaptHealth Corp., a national leader in providing patient-centered, healthcare-at-home solutions including home medical equipment, medical supplies, and related services, will release its fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results before the opening of the financial markets on Tuesday, February 24, 2026. Management will host a teleconference at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the results and business activities with analysts and investors.

articles.summary: AdaptHealth announced today that it has closed a $1.1 billion senior secured credit facility, consisting of a $325 million Term Loan A (the "Term Loan"), a $325 million Delayed Draw Term Loan (the "Delayed Draw Facility"), and a $450 million revolving line of credit (the "Revolver") (collectively, the "Credit Facility").

articles.summary: AdaptHealth announced today the appointment of Dale Wolf as Chair of the Board of Directors, effective July 1, 2024. Mr. Wolf has served on AdaptHealth’s Board since November 2019 and will assume the role from outgoing Chairman Richard Barasch. Additionally, Suzanne Foster, AdaptHealth’s Chief Executive Officer, has joined the Board of Directors, effective May 20, 2024.
articles.title: AdaptHealth Corp. Announces Changes to Board of Directors and Management

articles.summary: January 26, 2026 - AdaptHealth Corp., a national leader in providing patient-centered, healthcare-at-home solutions including home medical equipment, medical supplies, and related services, announced today that Moody’s Ratings (Moody’s) has recently upgraded the ratings of AdaptHealth, LLC, including the Corporate Family Rating to Ba2 from Ba3 and the senior unsecured notes rating from Ba3 to B1.
articles.title: AdaptHealth Corp. Announces Upgraded Moody’s Ratings

articles.summary: AdaptHealth Corp. announced today that S&P Global Ratings has recently upgraded its issue-level rating on the Company’s senior unsecured debt to ‘BB-’ from ‘B+’ and revised its recovery rating to ‘4’ from ‘5’.
articles.title: AdaptHealth Corp. Announces Upgraded S&P Global Issue-Level Rating on Senior Unsecured Debt - AdaptHealth
